effectSummary.ko: 잇단 사격·응시 사격이 표식 대상에게 처음 직접 적중하면 D50% 물리 추가 피해와 자원 4 회복을 한 번 얻습니다. 두 기술은 1초 재발동 간격을 공유합니다.
effectSummary.en: The first direct Successive Shots or Patient Shot hit on a marked target adds D50% secondary physical damage and restores 4 resource. Both share a 1s interval.

description.ko: 10m 안의 적 하나에게 0.15초 간격으로 D45% 화살 3발을 쏩니다. 한 번의 시전이며 기본 공격으로 세지 않습니다. 각 화살은 벽에 막힙니다.
description.en: Fire 3 D45% physical arrows at one target within 10m, 0.15s apart. This is one cast, not three basic attacks. Each arrow collides with walls.

description.ko: 0.9초 조준 후 12m 안의 적 하나에게 D240% 물리 피해를 줍니다. 적중 시 표식이 있으면 직접 피해가 가산 25% 증가합니다. 조준 중 이동하면 취소됩니다.
description.en: Aim for 0.9s, then deal D240% physical damage to one enemy within 12m. Gain +25% additive direct damage if the target is marked at impact. Moving during aim cancels the cast.

concept: A long patient hunter bow with a broad stable horn-and-yew grip, two nested aiming arcs physically fixed around its small amber sight and strong restrained recurved limbs. Aged black wood and pale ivory, taut bowstring, quietly precise silhouette.
prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept.
Create one original HELLSCRIPT legendary equipment icon. Metadata only, never write it in the image: DES_LA41, Patient Hunter's Bow, class Ranger, slot weapon.
Subject design: A long patient hunter bow with a broad stable horn-and-yew grip, two nested aiming arcs physically fixed around its small amber sight and strong restrained recurved limbs. Aged black wood and pale ivory, taut bowstring, quietly precise silhouette.
Power that informs materials and structure, not a spell illustration: The first direct Successive Shots or Patient Shot hit on a marked target adds D50% secondary physical damage and restores 4 resource. Both share a 1s interval.
Direct skill context: A07 Successive Shots — Fire 3 D45% physical arrows at one target within 10m, 0.15s apart. This is one cast, not three basic attacks. Each arrow collides with walls.; A08 Patient Shot — Aim for 0.9s, then deal D240% physical damage to one enemy within 12m. Gain +25% additive direct damage if the target is marked at impact. Moving during aim cancels the cast.
Style: dark gothic painterly fantasy equipment, worn and chipped metal, rough leather or aged cloth, strong directional upper-left highlights, deep but readable shadows. Earthy charcoal, silver, restrained old bronze; individual restrained effect colors only within the physical object. Large shapes, few decisive details, silhouette and material structure distinguish the item. Never a flat vector symbol.
Composition and file: square native PNG with real transparent alpha; the built-in 1254 by 1254 output is accepted, and 1024 by 1024 is also accepted. Preserve native pixels and alpha. ONE tangible item, or ONE tightly overlapping pair for hands or feet, with no wearer. Aim to contain the entire subject, including all tips and chain, within the central 76% with generous transparent padding. No part may be clipped or missing. Make the item strong and clear at 64px. Weapons diagonal; jewelry at three-quarter angle; other armor mostly frontal three-quarter view.
Transparency is mandatory: genuinely transparent surrounding area and internal empty holes with preserved native alpha, clean antialiased edges, no matte, no colored fringe. The image file must contain a real alpha channel; never paint a checkerboard.
Avoid: any text, letters, digits, readable runes, labels, watermark, UI frame, border, panel, badge, background, scenery, solid backdrop, gradient, floor, cast shadow, glow cloud, fog, detached particles, floating spell effects, duplicate items, collage, human body or hands. Equipment shape dominates; do not cover it with enormous effects. Do not copy any existing game icon.
